policy: Upstream trees are fetched at the pinned commit into build/upstream (ignored by git). Local changes are only carried as patches under the consuming component's patches/ directory. Nothing listed here is an original Shizuku implementation.

freedos-kernel.execution_mode: real-mode 16-bit (i8086/i386 instruction set, FAT12/16/32); not a protected-mode kernel
freedos-kernel.build: Open Watcom + NASM via `make all XCPU=386 XFAT=32` (mkfiles/owlinux.mak)

freedos-freecom.build: Open Watcom + NASM via `build.sh` (XMS swap enabled, language english)

seabios.note: SeaBIOS CSM build (Csm16.bin) and SeaVGABIOS (vgabios.bin), linked into the EFI image as byte arrays. Source headers: 'distributed under the terms of the GNU LGPLv3 license'; build scripts (not in the binary) are GPLv3.

picoefi.license: BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause-Patent AND BSD-3-Clause AND MIT AND LicenseRef-scancode-bsd-no-disclaimer-unmodified

csmwrap.license_note: CSMWrap's own code is LGPL-2.1 (LICENSE). Files under src/edk2 carry SPDX BSD-2-Clause-Patent headers (TianoCore EDK2). Each submodule keeps its own license (see submodules).
csmwrap.execution_mode: UEFI x86-64 application: exits boot services, installs SeaBIOS CSM16 below 1 MiB and legacy-boots the MBR of the disk it was loaded from; a BIOS proxy runs on one reserved AP
csmwrap.build: GNU make + gcc + nasm + xxd via `make BUILD_VERSION=<build_version> all` in a .git-free copy (shizukudos/csm/build.py)
csmwrap.version_note: Fixed copies of what `git describe --tags --always` printed for the pinned commits (CSMWrap) and `git describe --always --tags --long` (seabios submodule, no tags fetched) on 2026-09-29; fixed so later upstream tags cannot change the binary.

syslinux.commit_note: Abbreviated upstream commit as recorded in the Debian version string; the pin that is checked is the sha256 of every package and source file below.
syslinux.license_note: Syslinux core, isolinux.bin, ldlinux.c32 and memdisk are GPL-2.0-or-later; most com32 modules (menu.c32, mboot.c32, libcom32.c32, libutil.c32) are MIT (Expat) with some GPL-2.0-or-later files. Full per-file terms: usr/share/doc/syslinux-common/copyright, shipped with the media.

syslinux.note: host tool only: the mtools-based FAT installer used by tools/build_shizuku_se_disk.py; not shipped

syslinux.execution_mode: legacy BIOS boot loaders: isolinux.bin (El Torito no-emulation, and through isohdpfx.bin when the ISO is written to a disk), syslinux ldlinux.sys on the raw disk's FAT partition; mboot.c32 loads the Kernel64 Multiboot stub, memdisk emulates a BIOS disk from a disk/floppy image in RAM
syslinux.build: not built here: the pinned distribution binaries are extracted with dpkg-deb -x (shizukudos/tools/shzlib.py ensure_deb_upstream); the Debian source package (dsc + orig + debian tarballs) is shipped on the media as corresponding source

reactos.license: GPL-2.0 (COPYING is the GPLv2 text; the corpus driver sources state GPL-2.0+ or 'GPL - See COPYING'). Third-party components used by the corpus, per media/doc/3rd Party Files.txt: MS-PL (drivers/storage/class/classpnp, disk, cdrom), MIT (sdk/lib/drivers/wdf = Microsoft WDF), BSD-3-Clause (drivers/network/dd/netkvm), BSD (drivers/bus/pcix, COPYING.ARM), UniATA BSD-style licence (drivers/storage/ide/uniata)
reactos.execution_mode: NT kernel-mode driver sources (x64 WDM), compiled unmodified as the NT driver corpus
reactos.build: shizukudos/ntdrv/corpus/build.py: each driver built from its own CMakeLists.txt (evaluated by the script) with x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc (C++: x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ or clang++) against the ReactOS sdk/include headers, ReactOS host tools (hpp, spec2def, pefixup, geninc, asmpp, widl, gcc_plugin_seh) built from this tree, linked --subsystem native with import libraries generated from the ReactOS .spec files (no RosBE, no CMake)

virtio-win.execution_mode: NT kernel-mode driver sources (NetKVM NDIS 6.x, viostor StorPort, vioinput/viogpudo KMDF/WDM)
virtio-win.build: shizukudos/ntdrv/corpus/build.py + corpus/vcxproj.py: viostor, NetKVM (NDIS 6.85), vioinput (KMDF), viogpudo (WDDM DOD) attempted from their .vcxproj with the ReactOS headers standing in for the WDK; results in docs/shizukudos10/DRIVER_CORPUS.md

windows-driver-frameworks.execution_mode: KMDF (Wdf01000.sys) and UMDF v2 framework sources; assessed against the copy ReactOS carries (sdk/lib/drivers/wdf, built by the corpus)
windows-driver-frameworks.build: not built from this tree (MSBuild/WDK project); the ReactOS copy of the same sources (KMDF 1.17) is built by shizukudos/ntdrv/corpus/build.py (wdf01000, wdfldr); assessment in docs/shizukudos10/DRIVER_CORPUS.md

libs/tomcrypt.license: LibTomCrypt dual licence: public domain dedication OR WTFPL-2.0

wine.execution_mode: PE32+ user-mode DLLs (x86_64) built with mingw-w64 against Wine's own include/ tree; the Unix side (unixlib) of a DLL is never built
wine.build: shizukudos/win64/wineport/build.py: host configure (--enable-win64, every optional library disabled) only for widl/wrc and the generated headers, then each DLL with x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc; exports come from the .spec file minus stub entries
wine.linking_note: The Wine DLLs are statically linked with Shizuku-original GPL-2.0-only support code (wineport/crt, wineport/glue); the combined DLLs are distributed under GPL-2.0 as LGPL-2.1 section 3 permits.

data_files_used.fonts/tahoma.ttf: Wine's own Tahoma replacement (LGPL-2.1-or-later), packed unmodified as \SHZ\FONTS\tahoma.ttf
data_files_used.fonts/tahomabd.ttf: Wine's own Tahoma Bold replacement (LGPL-2.1-or-later), packed unmodified as \SHZ\FONTS\tahomabd.ttf

freetype.license: FTL OR GPL-2.0-or-later (dual); used here under GPL-2.0-or-later
freetype.execution_mode: static library linked into the PE dwrite.dll (x86_64, mingw-w64), no platform-specific code
freetype.build: shizukudos/win64/wineport/build.py: the module sources listed in wineport/modules.json with a module list header (wineport/freetype/shz_ftmodule.h)

noto-fonts.execution_mode: font data (variable TrueType), packed unmodified into WIN64.IMG as \SHZ\FONTS\*.ttf
noto-fonts.build: partial, sparse fetch of the pinned commit (only the three family directories); files are not modified

open-watcom-v2.note: Rolling CI tag: upstream replaces the archive with every CI build (twice within hours on 2026-09-29/30). sha256 is the snapshot the last full verification used (2026-09-29, host suite PASS); a different archive is used with a warning, its hash is recorded in build/tools/ow/.snapshot-sha256 and by the host suite (SKIP with the used hash), and DOS16 reproducibility is compared within each run.

virglrenderer-headers.note: Unmodified copies used by host tests only (see PINNED.txt there); never compiled into the guest.
